author: _Phyre
body:
Ill just jump right in...

I think there should be a map icon on the website next to the "Home" button, so new or people who just want to see some maps that have been added, or Dismissed.. That type of thing, i think it would be cool if you take the creators post of the Map release and take the photo album (And if the map is going to be added) paste the photo album of the map next to the Name of the map and creator.. For example:



Map                                       | Creator                                       | Album & Date                                         |
Galloway                               | vsplesk101                                | (link to album)
Proelium                               | sweeper                                     | (link to album)


if you agree make sure to +1 And all that crap :P. xD But really i think this would be a great addition to the site :P
